flash_memory_map.full_flash: Typically 2MB or 4MB variants; calibration in dedicated blocks
flash_memory_map.calibration_region: Map blocks often starting ~0x80000 range (verify per SW)

checksum.description: EDC17 uses multipoint checksums similar to EDC16 but with Tricore specific and more regions. Primary use community CRC32 multipoint or WinOLS-compatible. Correction via same practical force-to-0 approach until exact poly verified against dumps. Extend checksum.rs EDC16 path for EDC17 sizes.
checksum.notes: Verify with your own dumps + WinOLS or public tools. Do not flash uncorrected bins.

security_access.reference: security.rs patterns + 2byte-keys.txt for known public algos; full Bosch seedkey often proprietary

maps_and_xdf.description: Community starting maps for IQ, driver wish, boost, rail, smoke limiters, EGR. Addresses vary heavily by software version — always verify with your bin. Auto-load will use placeholder refined addresses until refined per SW ID.

notes: Added in v0.7.0 for industry expansion. Protocol ready via existing CAN/UDS. Checksum and exact maps require per-software verification from personal dumps. Expands DIY coverage beyond EDC16/P01 without commercial lock-in.
